unique_value: each tool decision is bound to an immutable policy hash and content-addressed tool input
allow/refuse outcomes carry stable reason codes and a deterministic transcript fingerprint
hard red-line tools refuse independently of the general allow-list and replay recomputes the same decision contract

lineage_distinction.anthropic-safety-monitor: broader proposed-action safety boundary; this repository specializes in content-addressed decision transcripts and deterministic replay identity
lineage_distinction.anthropic-refusal-replay-harness: golden refusal regression suite; this repository binds each individual decision to policy hash, input digest, verdict, reason, and fingerprint

capability_contribution.ownership: This repository remains the owning Anthropic-specialist implementation of deterministic policy-bound tool transcripts; capability extraction preserves repository identity and lineage.

next_evolution: Bind replay batches to immutable policy-version provenance and a sequence root so policy drift, transcript reordering, omission, and tampering are detectable without weakening deterministic refusal semantics.
nonclaims: repository relationships do not imply exercised integration
